Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use Artisan's Tools as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 2
Order: Recruit

A forge for building Constructs.

Recruit: Construct. The hirelings build a Construct from the Forge Constructs table, for the time and cost shown.

Constructs made here count as Bastion Defenders; remove those you lose from your roster. You can choose not to count some of them, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion and act according to their nature, using their Monster Manual stat blocks.

ConstructTimeCost
Animated Armor14 days1,000 GP
Animated Broom7 days250 GP

Animated Rug of Smothering21 days2,000 GP
Helmed Horror42 days5,000 GP
Scarecrow14 days1,000 GP
Shield Guardian63 days25,000 GP
Warforged Titan*250 days200,000 GP

*The Warforged Titan appears in Eberron: Rising from the Last War. Building new ones is illegal under the Treaty of Korth, which ended the Last War; breaking the treaty risks reigniting open war across Khorvaire.

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
